prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Adoption: Move the sign_in screen after the pet adoption flow so users build an emotional connection with their pet before being asked to create an account. (why: Sign-in early in onboarding drops conversion to 72.9%; delaying account creation until after pet creation increases user investment.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Grid View Pet Companion Redesign: Redesign pet selection screen into a visual grid featuring interactive animations for each pet choice. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off (60.9% conversion) and long median completion time (89s); a visual grid accelerates companion selection.)
2: [home, wait_info] Interactive Desktop Tips During Wait: Show revolving desktop shortcut tips and pet care hints while the pet finishes loading in the background. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs due to lack of progress engagement.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safety Notice: Add an explicit safety badge and hint assuring users that signing in preserves and syncs their existing pet data. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Certificate Reward: Add an official adoption badge and celebratory confirmation to the certificate screen upon finishing pet setup. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion); reinforcing completion with a reward boosts motivation.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Simplified Path Choice Layout: Change path selection to a structured two-column layout with concise path option cards. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s; presenting cleaner side-by-side choices helps users decide faster.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Notification Prompt: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users know exactly when their pet appears. (why: 3 support emails report pets failing to appear on desktop or users missing app startup during long load times.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Quick Shortcut Guide: Add a visual keyboard shortcut callout on the home completion screen detailing how to toggle desktop pet visibility. (why: Post-onboarding support requests reflect confusion on how to show, hide, or trigger pet interactions on desktop.)
